verdict.rationale: Teller documents webhooks that are configured from the Dashboard against a URL in your app, and fire when changes are detected in user enrollments or their financial data. That covers the core push-instead-of-poll need and implies connection-state and data-change events. However, the pack never confirms that payloads are signed, never lists specific event types, and offers no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: webhook signature verification, an explicit event catalog (new transactions, balance updates, enrollment/connection state), independent or hands-on corroboration.
